name: team-scaling
description: Scaling up or scaling down, every change costs your team output.

scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && touch dist/.nojekyll && git -C dist init -q -b gh-pages && git -C dist add -A && git -C dist commit -q -m deploy && git -C dist push -f -q "$(git remote get-url origin)" gh-pages && rm -rf dist/.git
